description: Get the FULL structure of one US electricity tariff by its URDB label — every energy-charge tier and time-of-use period, the 12x24 month-by-hour period schedules for weekdays and weekends, demand charges, flat demand by month, minimum monthly charge, voltage category and service type. This is what you need to actually compute a bill. Labels come from urdb_search_rates.

_apiKey.description: Your own free NREL API key. Optional — the shared DEMO_KEY works at a low rate limit.

label.description: URDB rate label (24-char hex id) from urdb_search_rates, e.g. "539f6b25ec4f024411ec98c9"

name: urdb_rate_detail
title: Urdb Rate Detail
